subject: Request: Temporary H200 burst allowance + SKU tier exception
messages:
From: Bryce Halvorsen <bryce@lumosbio.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Capacity request — short H200 burst + SKU tier ask

Jonas,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — excited about Redwood's latency profile. We're finalizing our internal capacity plan and have a short, time-boxed need through August: ~6 weeks where peak throughput requires H200-class accelerators for specific inference pipelines. Current committed Dedicated capacity is in the H100 family and swapping would be disruptive for our stack. Two asks: 

1) Temporary H200 burst allowance: allow LumosBio to route up to 40% of token volume to H200 instances for up to 6 weeks. We'll keep average within our committed reservation but need headroom for model retraining validation.
2) SKU tier exception: allow a single-month surcharge cap instead of standard overage rates if H200 capacity is limited and you need to route us to alternative SKUs.

We understand this is non-standard — happy to sign an addendum and put in a security attestation (attached). Can we get an estimated overage cap and an approvals timeline? We need final terms by EOD Monday to lock procurement.

Attachments: Lumos_Proposal_v2.pdf, SOC2_Attestation.pdf

Best,
Bryce
VP Product Operations
LumosBio
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Bryce Halvorsen <bryce@lumosbio.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity request — short H200 burst + SKU tier ask

Bryce —

Thanks for the clear ask and the proposal. I put Lauren (Deal Desk) on copy to run the legal/pricing side. Short answer: we can consider a short-term H200 burst allowance but need an executive exception for both the SKU-tier guarantee and the overage cap.

Proposed next steps:
- Lauren to review and propose an overage cap and min-commit guardrails
- I can provisionally hold burst capacity on the site for 72 hours while approvals happen
- If approved, we'll attach a one-month addendum (DocuSign) and apply a temporary routing policy

Can you confirm the exact dates (start/end) you want the burst to be active? That'll help us map to availability windows.

Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-02T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Capacity request — short H200 burst + SKU tier ask

Jonas / Karthik — forwarding Lumos's ask. High level: they need a 6-week window with the ability to burst into H200s up to 40% of volume. They also want a single-month surcharge cap in lieu of our usual overage calc if we must route to other SKUs.

Pricing options I ran (prelim):
- Option A (conservative): Approve burst allowance; standard overage rates apply. No surcharge cap.
- Option B (preferred for relationship): Approve burst + one-month surcharge capped at 1.5x committed unit price for any forced SKU substitution. Requires Exec sign-off; we can do it as a conditional addendum with a DocuSign.

Risks: sets precedent; can be mitigated by time-boxing, requiring SOC2 attestation (they attached), and a one-week notice to cancel burst if capacity tightens.

Requested approval ask to Execs (Vanessa):
- Authorize Option B for LumosBio (6 weeks max; up to 40% H200 routing; 1.5x surcharge cap for forced SKU switches).
- Allow Jonas to hold a provisional burst reservation for 72 hours while paperwork completes.

If we get a yes, I'll draft the addendum and attach to the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/1187

—Lauren
Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-04T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity request — short H200 burst + SKU tier ask (EXEC APPROVAL)

Team — thanks for the clear framing. I discussed with Finance and Product Ops. Approve Option B with the following binding conditions: 

1) Timebox the exception: max 6 weeks from the start date Lumos confirms (no auto-renew).
2) Surcharge cap: 1.5x committed unit price applied only to tokens routed to a different SKU than their committed reservation; any overage outside the window billed at standard rates thereafter.
3) Notice & kill-switch: Redwood can revoke burst routing with 7 days' notice if H200 utilization exceeds 85% across the region for two consecutive days.
4) Security/customer commitments: Lumos must sign the addendum and provide the SOC attestation.
5) Provisional reservation: Jonas may hold a 72-hour provisional slot; upon signed DocuSign addendum, we will formalize the routing policy and billing terms.

Jonas — please confirm the exact start/end dates in the DocuSign. Lauren — draft the addendum with these bullets and attach the DocuSign link to the HubSpot deal. I authorize you to proceed.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
